notes.title: Minor Level Update
notes.content:
Added a new relaxing side level: "Secrets of the Secret Garden"
[b]Wishing everyone a pleasant gaming experience![/b]

notes.title: Tiny update
notes.content: The hint effects in Level 4 have become more noticeable

notes.title: Minor Updates
notes.content: Added hint feature to the "Find the Cat" level

notes.title: Added 2 new levels
notes.content:
[b]Timed Mini-Game Level: [/b]Help Farmer Clark find his mischievous dog.
[b]Potentially Challenging Hidden Object Level:[/b] Help Magician Edward retrieve the scattered "Stellar Power" in the room.

[b]Thank you for your support, and we wish you all a pleasant gaming experience![/b]

notes.title: Adjusted the HP of the final stage
notes.content: It has been significantly reduced, now requiring only 133 vigorous clicks to complete, with a 60-hit combo.

notes.title: Adjusted the drag speed again
notes.content:
The drag speed now adapts to the screen resolution and can also be customized. We hope the new maximum speed feels blazing fast!

Fixed an issue where the "Weather Control Master" achievement could not be obtained on sunny days. We apologize to the player who completed the third level three times.

Wishing everyone a pleasant gaming experience!

notes.title: Added custom drag speed functionality and addressed some minor issues:
notes.content:
Custom drag speed functionality allows the speed to be increased by up to 2x.

Removed the chromatic aberration effect around the edges of the screen.

Fixed an issue where dragging would continue after releasing the button.

notes.title: Added left button to move the camera.
notes.content: Adjusted the camera movement speed for some levels.

notes.title: Sound Effect Volume Bug Fixes.
notes.content: Fix the issue where the volume of pickup, storyline, and other sound effects cannot be properly turned off.

notes.title: Here are some minor updates
notes.content:
Added hint text to Level 8.
Enlarged the level numbers on achievement images for better visibility.
